entities.name: tRNA pseudouridine synthase A
observations: Exact sequence match to reviewed UniProt Q12VJ7 from Methanococcoides burtonii; annotated to form pseudouridine at tRNA positions 38, 39, and 40.

entities.name: tRNA uridine-to-pseudouridine isomerization
observations: Converts uridine at tRNA position 38, 39, or 40 to pseudouridine at the same position; Rhea RHEA:22376 (also RHEA:10085 and RHEA:10087).
